name: allinle
description: ALLINLE 德州扑克记账与非现金化牌技训练工具

scripts.dev:api: sh -c 'launchctl unload ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.allinle.api.plist 2>/dev/null; export PATH=/Users/lei/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/bin/fallback:/Users/lei/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/bin:/Users/lei/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/node/bin:$PATH; set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; set +a; pnpm --filter @allinle/api dev'
scripts.build: export PATH=/Users/lei/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/bin/fallback:/Users/lei/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/bin:/Users/lei/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/node/bin:$PATH && pnpm --filter @allinle/shared build && pnpm --filter @allinle/api build && pnpm --filter @allinle/admin build
scripts.start:api: launchctl load ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.allinle.api.plist && sleep 1 && launchctl list | grep com.allinle.api
scripts.stop:api: launchctl unload ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.allinle.api.plist && sleep 1 && echo 'com.allinle.api stopped' && lsof -i :3000 2>/dev/null || echo 'Port 3000 is free'
scripts.restart:api: launchctl unload ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.allinle.api.plist 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; launchctl load ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.allinle.api.plist && sleep 1 && launchctl list | grep com.allinle.api
scripts.status:api: sh -c 'echo "=== launchd service ===" && launchctl list | grep com.allinle.api && echo "" && echo "=== Port 3000 ===" && lsof -i :3000 2>/dev/null || echo "Port 3000 is free" && echo "" && echo "=== Recent logs ===" && tail -20 /tmp/allinle-api-out.log 2>/dev/null || echo "No logs"'
scripts.kill:all: launchctl unload ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.allinle.api.plist 2>/dev/null; lsof -ti :5173 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; echo 'All ports cleared'
scripts.typecheck: export PATH=/Users/lei/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/bin/fallback:/Users/lei/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/bin:/Users/lei/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/node/bin:$PATH && pnpm --filter @allinle/shared typecheck && pnpm --filter @allinle/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @allinle/admin typecheck && pnpm --filter @allinle/miniprogram typecheck
